description: Curated index of public research datasets for undergraduate capstone projects.

datasets.name: NIH Chest X-ray 14
datasets.data_modality: Medical DICOM / PNG Images + CSV Metadata
datasets.target_variable: 14 Binary Multilabel Pathologies (Atelectasis, Cardiomegaly, Effusion, Infiltration, Mass, Nodule, Pneumonia, Pneumothorax, Consolidation, Edema, Emphysema, Fibrosis, Pleural Thickening, Hernia)
datasets.suitability_notes: Highly suitable for multi-label classification and Grad-CAM interpretability. Insufficient for 3D volumetric analysis (requires CT scans).

datasets.name: MIMIC-IV Clinical Database
datasets.source_portal: PhysioNet / MIT Laboratory for Computational Physiology
datasets.data_modality: Relational Tabular EHR (Demographics, Vitals, Labs, Medications)
datasets.target_variable: In-Hospital Mortality, ICU Length-of-Stay, Sepsis Onset (SOFA Score)
datasets.suitability_notes: Gold standard for clinical machine learning and time-series risk forecasting. Requires completion of CITI human research training for access.

datasets.name: Credit Card Fraud Detection Benchmark
datasets.suitability_notes: Ideal for testing extreme class imbalance, anomaly detection, and cost-sensitive classification. Features are PCA-anonymized; lacks raw account graph links.

datasets.name: IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection
datasets.source_portal: IEEE Computational Intelligence Society / Vesta / Kaggle
datasets.data_modality: Rich Tabular Features (Device Info, Identity, Transaction)
datasets.suitability_notes: Sufficient relational structure to construct bipartite transaction graphs and user-device entity resolution trees.

datasets.name: CIC-IDS2017 Network Intrusion Detection
datasets.size_samples: 2,830,743 labeled network flow records across 5 days (1.8GB CSV / 50GB PCAP)
datasets.data_modality: Network Packet Captures (PCAP) + Extracted NetFlow CSV
datasets.target_variable: Attack Category (Benign, DoS/DDoS, PortScan, Botnet, Infiltration, Web Attack, Heartbleed)
datasets.suitability_notes: Standard benchmark for intrusion detection, flow classifiers, and random forest telemetry evaluation.

datasets.name: NREL National Solar Radiation Database (NSRDB)
datasets.license: U.S. Public Domain / NREL Open Access
datasets.size_samples: Half-hourly physical solar irradiance across North America, 1998-2023
datasets.target_variable: Hourly / Daily Solar PV Wattage Output
datasets.suitability_notes: Excellent for time-series forecasting, LSTM/Transformer models, and microgrid renewable forecasting.

datasets.name: MIMII Industrial Machine Acoustic Defect Sound
datasets.size_samples: 26,092 ten-second audio clips across 4 industrial machine types (valves, pumps, fans, slide rails)
datasets.target_variable: Machine Condition (Normal vs Anomalous Operation at -6dB, 0dB, +6dB SNR)
datasets.suitability_notes: Perfect for TinyML on-device audio anomaly classifiers on microcontrollers (sub-128KB models).

datasets.name: CodeSearchNet Python Corpus
datasets.size_samples: 2,000,000+ Python functions with parsed docstrings & AST tokens (1.5GB)
datasets.data_modality: Source Code Text + Tokenized AST Streams
datasets.target_variable: Code-Docstring Semantic Retrieval & Function Vulnerability Classification
datasets.suitability_notes: Ideal for training code embeddings, AST vulnerability visitors, and semantic code clone detectors.
